lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Mr. Macal, we have a problem. The suite was double-booked. The client is here now, and he is not happy.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I understand. I'm sorry about this. Give me two minutes — I mean, I'll fix it now.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: Two minutes? I've been waiting one hour. My family is outside. This is not okay.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: You're right. Let me confirm one thing, and I promise — you'll have a room tonight.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَهْلًا يَا صَاحْبِي! أَنَا مَحْمُود، وَمَعَاك فِي Yalla Fluent... النَّهَارْدَة مَاكَال عِنْدُه مُشْكِلَة كَبِيرَة، زَبُون زَعْلَان جِدًّا، وَالْأُوضَة مَحْجُوزَة مَرَّتَيْن!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: اسْمَع كَوَيْس... مَاكَال لَازِم يِهَدِّي الْوَضْع، وَيِتَكَلَّم بِإِنْجِلِيزِي تَحْت الضَّغْط. رَكِّز عَلَى تَلَاتَة تَعْبِيرَات:

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَوَّلًا... I'm sorry about this... يَعْنِي أَنَا آسِف عَلَى دَه. تَانِيًا... Let me confirm one thing... يَعْنِي خَلِّينِي أَتْأَكَّد مِنْ حَاجَة. وَتَالْتًا... you'll have a room tonight... يَعْنِي هَتْخُد أُوضَة النَّهَارْدَة بِاللَّيْل!
lines.direction: clear, teaching each phrase with care

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَالَّا بِنَا نِسْمَع مَاكَال... وَشُوف هُوَ هَيِقْدَر يِهَدِّي الزَّبُون وَلَا لَأ!

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: Look, I don't want excuses. I booked this suite three weeks ago. Three weeks! And now your man at the desk tells me there's no room.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I'm sorry about this, sir. I really am. I've been checking the system since you arrived, and I can see the mistake is on our side.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: On your side? My wife and my two kids are sitting in the car. They are tired. What am I supposed to tell them?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: You're right, and I understand. Let me confirm one thing with the front desk, and I'll come back to you in one minute.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: One minute. Not one hour. I have been waiting since four o'clock.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I know. I know. And I live here since two years, so I know how important this weekend is for families like yours.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: Fine. But if there is no room tonight, I want a full refund and I am writing to the manager.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I hear you. If we can't find the suite, I'll move you to our best available room tonight, and we'll sort out the refund for the difference. But I promise you — you'll have a room tonight.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: A room with two beds. For the kids. That is the minimum.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Two beds, yes. Let me call the desk right now. Please, sit for a moment, and I'll bring you cold water for your family.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: Okay. Okay, I will wait. But please — two beds.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Two beds. I've got it. Thank you for your patience, sir.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّب، يَا صَاحْبِي... خُد بَالَك مِنْ تَلَاتَة تَعْبِيرَات، هُمَّا اللي أَنْقَذُوا مَاكَال!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَوَّلًا... I'm sorry about this. يَعْنِي أَنَا آسِف عَلَى دَه. بِنِقُولْهَا لَمَّا الغَلَطَة مِنْ نَاحْيِتْنَا، وَمِشْ عَايِزِين نِبَرِّر، عَايِزِين نِعْتَرِف. مَثَلًا... I'm sorry about this, sir، دِي كَفَايَة عَشَان تِهَدِّي الْحَدِيث.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: تَانِيًا... Let me confirm one thing. يَعْنِي خَلِّينِي أَتْأَكَّد مِنْ حَاجَة. بِنِقُولْهَا لَمَّا عَايِز تِكْسِب وَقْت، وَتَرْجَع بِمَعْلُومَة صَحِيحَة. مَثَلًا... Let me confirm one thing with the front desk.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَتَالْتًا... you'll have a room tonight. يَعْنِي هَتْخُد أُوضَة النَّهَارْدَة بِاللَّيْل. دِي وَعْد وَاضِح، بِتَدِّي الزَّبُون أَمَل، وَلَازِم تِوَفِّي بِيه!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَمَّا الْغَلَطَة... مَاكَال قَالَ I live here since two years. الْغَلَطَة دِي جَايَة مِنْ الْعَرَبِي، لِأَنَّنَا بِنِقُول أَنَا عَايِش هِنَا مِنْ سَنِتَيْن. بِالْإِنْجِلِيزِي الصَّح... I've lived here for two years. اِسْتَخْدِم for مَعَ الْعَدَد، وَhave plus p.p. لِلْحَالَة الْمُسْتَمِرَّة.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَالَّا... نِكَمِّل وَنِشُوف مَاكَال هَيِعْمِل إِيه مَعَ الْفْرُونْت دِيسْك!

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Sir — good news. I've confirmed it with the front desk. We have a family suite with two beds, and it's yours tonight.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: Two beds? Really? And the price? I don't want any surprises on the bill.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Same price you booked. I've lived here for two years, and I know a tired family needs rest, not paperwork. The refund difference — forget it. Consider it handled.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: Handled? Hmm. You know, most people just give me excuses. You didn't. My wife will be happy. Thank you... Macal, right?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: That's me. I'll walk your family to the suite myself and bring the water. If anything is wrong tonight, ask for me personally.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: Good. Because my boss will hear about this — and I want to tell her something positive for once. She runs Rising Voices, by the way.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Wait — Rising Voices? The fellowship? Your boss is... Nour's director?

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: That's her. Nour speaks highly of you. My director wants a follow-up call tomorrow about the booking mess. She asked if you'd handle it.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I... yes. I'll take the call. But first, let's get your family inside. One thing at a time tonight.

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.text: Then I'll tell her you said yes. Good luck, Macal. You'll need it — she doesn't forgive mistakes easily.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Great. So tomorrow I explain a double booking... to the woman who decides my future. If I've lived here for two years, I should know how to survive one phone call. Right?

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّب يَا صَاحْبِي، خَلِّينَا نِرَاجِع... I'm sorry about this، و Let me confirm one thing، و you'll have a room tonight.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَعِبَارَة الْحَلْقَة النَّهَارْدَة... آسِف عَلَى الْإِزْعَاج، يَا سَيِّدِي. I'm sorry for the inconvenience, sir. دِي بِنِقُولْهَا لَمَّا الْغَلَطَة كَبِيرَة شْوَيَّة، وَالزَّبُون لِسَّه زَعْلَان!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَمَاكَال عَمَل حَاجَة صَعْبَة جِدًّا... فَضَل هَادِي تَحْت الضَّغْط، وَوَعَد بِحَلّ... وَخَلَّى الْغَلَطَة تَبْقَى فُرْصَة!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: تَعَالَى قُول لِي إِنْتَ... إِمْتَى آخِر مَرَّة اعْتَذَرْت بِالْإِنْجِلِيزِي؟ اِبْعَت لِي عَلَى التِّلِيجْرَام، وَاشْتَرِك فِي الْبُودْكَاسْت عَشَان مِش تِفُوتَك حَلْقَة!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَمَرَّة جَايَة... مَاكَال هَيِتْكَلِّم مَعَ مُدِيرَة نُور نَفْسِهَا. يَا تُرَى هَيِقُول إِيه؟ يَالَّا، نِشُوف!
